all_steps: Open BE/ui.txt and switch to Search panel.
Use sidebar controls to set query, replacement, regex, case, and search field.
Run Replace All in FILE scope, then LOCALE/POOL scopes via Preferences, and confirm modal summary each time.
Cancel one confirmation and verify no replacement is applied for that run.
